findings.identity_explanation: Tag FP-03 matches exactly across CR:FP-03, ES:FP-03, FM:TFM-0203, COM-06 and WAR-07. Model RF-DS150, serial RFD-15033 and location Basement 1 fire pump room agree wherever stated. No possible or uncertain matches.

exceptions.finding: No O&M manual covers FP-03. OM-05 excludes it and only promises a separate engine supplier manual 'to be issued'; a promise is not the document (Evidence 2.3). FP-03 is a life-safety asset (diesel standby fire pump), so any open exception is critical and escalates (Readiness 3.1, Escalation 2.1).

evidence.quote: The diesel fire pump FP-03 is covered by a separate manual from the engine supplier, to be issued.

exceptions.responsible_party: Embral Fire Systems (installing subcontractor), through Halvorn Contracting
exceptions.next_action: Request the engine supplier O&M manual for FP-03, listing FP-03 in its Covers line, before acceptance review. FM operations manager to be consulted (Escalation 1.2).

findings.summary: FP-03 (diesel standby fire pump, life-safety) has a signed, passed commissioning certificate (COM-06), a valid warranty to 2028-09-29 (WAR-07) with matching serial, an FM record and a PPM plan, and identity is consistent. However, no O&M manual covers it: OM-05 says a separate engine supplier manual is 'to be issued'. As a life-safety asset with an open exception it is not ready for acceptance and is escalated.
findings.escalate_to: FM handover manager, consulting the FM operations manager
findings.escalation_reason: Life-safety asset (diesel standby fire pump) has an open exception: the O&M manual is missing (Escalation 2.1). They must decide whether to approve the clarification request and how to treat FP-03 before the 24 November 2026 handover.
findings.clarification_to: Halvorn Contracting project manager (for Embral Fire Systems)
findings.clarification_subject: FP-03 diesel standby fire pump: O&M manual required
findings.clarification_body:
Dear Halvorn Contracting project manager,

For handover of Sarava Tower (planned 24 November 2026), we have no O&M manual covering FP-03 (diesel standby fire pump, RF-DS150, serial RFD-15033). OM-05 covers FP-01, FP-02 and SPR-01 only and states that FP-03 is covered by a separate engine supplier manual 'to be issued'.

Please ask Embral Fire Systems to issue that manual, with FP-03 listed in its Covers line, and confirm the date it will be provided. A promise that it will follow cannot be treated as the document.

Thank you.
uncertainties: Whether the engine supplier manual exists yet and when it will be issued is unknown.
Warranty terms require weekly test runs to be recorded; no weekly run records were seen, so whether this condition is being met is unknown.
